before: Picture commands on a chart's saved fallback picture in mc:AlternateContent edited only the fallback branch, and deleting it removed only the fallback and left the chart branch. Drawing ops on a drawn or placeholder chart refused with not-a-picture-drawing, including delete.
after: A chart (classic or chartex, bare or as the Choice of mc:AlternateContent) is recognized from the tree alone, whatever renderers are installed. Resize, crop, position, wrap, replace, metadata, lock and transform ops on the wrapper, either branch or a bare chart drawing refuse with chart-drawing and change nothing, whether the page draws the chart, shows its fallback, or shows a placeholder. A delete removes the whole mc:AlternateContent wrapper, or the bare chart drawing, as one undo step, unless the chart drawing's own @locked or noSelect lock refuses it with drawing-locked.
reason: The change narrows which drawing ops apply and widens one delete to the wrapper node that is already the run-level drawing atom. The rule reads only the tree, so a participant with the drawing module and one without make the same decision. It adds no shared state, operations, snapshot fields or protocol messages. Refused edits write nothing, and the whole-chart delete and its undo synchronize as ordinary node removal.
